verdict.rationale: Box documents its own event feed, which applications can subscribe to for actions across an enterprise, either in real time or by querying historical records. That is a change feed rather than a full re-crawl. However, the pack never describes a cursor or stream-position token, or 'changes since last call' semantics, so incremental delta behavior is only implied. Webhooks are push notifications and belong to a different story. Missing for 10: explicit cursor/stream-position documentation, a description of delta semantics (only changes since the last call), hands-on or independent corroboration of efficient incremental sync.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sync efficiently — a cursor/delta endpoint returns only what changed since my last call instead of forcing a full re-crawl

citations.quote: The event feed provides a way for an application to subscribe to any actions performed by any user, users, or service in an enterprise.
Subscribe to user or enterprise events in Box, compare stream types, and monitor actions in real time or query historical records.
